name: Raithwaite Sandsend
accommodation: En-suite rooms, family suites and dog-friendly rooms
suitableFor: Couples and families wanting a hotel with spa
beachAccess: Sandsend beach described as on the doorstep
confirmedFeatures: Indoor pool, steam room, sauna, spa treatments, Restaurant and Bar 1822, own surf school
overview: An estate hotel set in woodland and gardens at Sandsend, just north of Whitby, with en-suite rooms, family suites and dog-friendly rooms. It has an indoor pool, sauna and spa, and the hotel says Sandsend beach is on its doorstep.
surfTripFit: The hotel runs its own surf school from Sandsend beach, and the pool and sauna help after a cold session.
